policies.ids: Generate immutable UUIDs (UUIDv7 may be generated by service); never use phone or union_id as primary key.
policies.tenant_site: Every business fact carries immutable tenant_id and site_id; tenant directory and customer identity anchor are explicit exceptions. Composite FKs use RESTRICT; no cross-tenant/site joins.
policies.time: UTC DATETIME(3); keep occurred_at separate from created_at; validity is half-open [effective_from,effective_to).
policies.money: Monetary amounts are DECIMAL(18,2) paired with ISO currency_code; never infer currency.
policies.sensitive_data: Encrypt sensitive payloads and direct identifiers with KMS envelope encryption; use HMAC lookup indexes separately. Never log secrets or health content.
policies.reservation_lock: Reserve every 5-minute resource bucket in one transaction using unique (tenant_id,site_id,resource_id,slot_start_utc); insert sorted buckets and roll back all on conflict.
policies.rule_snapshots: Bookings, work orders, sends, and reports pin the applicable published service/SOP/template/consent/frequency/definition versions; later rule edits do not rewrite existing facts.
policies.synthetic_and_database: All examples and tests use synthetic values. No DDL execution and no production database connection.
policies.health_consent: A health record requires a same-tenant/site customer reference and an active CRM consent for the health purpose and field scope; health ownership remains unconfirmed and all health writes stay disabled.
policies.mer_read_only: Wish consumes MER order, refund, product, and inventory facts through minimized references only. mkt_order_ref is a read-only Commerce/MER reference; a separate Wish-owned benefit map may reference an MER SKU but never writes MER facts.
policies.canonical_aliases: Section 12/13 logical names that describe the same appointment, resource lock, work order, service card, or ledger fact extend/map to the canonical entity; do not create parallel physical tables or writers.
policies.legacy_and_extension_mapping: Section 12/13 names that describe an existing canonical fact are aliases/extensions in logical_name_mappings; review field mapping and writer before rollout. No synonym creates a second physical writer.
